title: Tensor product of modules over a commutative ring
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $M,N$ $R$-modules. The *tensor product* $M\otimes_RN$ is an $R$-module together with an $R$-bilinear map $M\times N\to M\otimes_RN$, $(x,y)\mapsto x\otimes y$, such that for every $R$-module $P$ and every $R$-bilinear map $\beta:M\times N\to P$ there is a unique $R$-linear map $\hat\beta:M\otimes_RN\to P$ with $\hat\beta(x\otimes y)=\beta(x,y)$; it is constructed as the free $R$-module on $M\times N$ modulo the bilinearity relations, is unique up to unique isomorphism, and is generated as an $R$-module by the elements $x\otimes y$. For an $R$-linear map $f:N\to P$ the $R$-linear map $f\otimes\mathrm{id}_M:N\otimes_RM\to P\otimes_RM$ is the one with $y\otimes x\mapsto f(y)\otimes x$; $f\mapsto f\otimes\mathrm{id}_M$ is $R$-linear, sends $0$ to $0$ and is compatible with composition and identities: $(g\circ f)\otimes\mathrm{id}_M=(g\otimes\mathrm{id}_M)\circ(f\otimes\mathrm{id}_M)$, $\mathrm{id}_N\otimes\mathrm{id}_M=\mathrm{id}$.
